name: wa
description: Safety-first WhatsApp tools: draft-gated sends, enforced rate limits, append-only audit.
long_description:
Connects Claude Desktop to a local `wad` WhatsApp daemon over its unix socket. Every tool call traverses the daemon's non-bypassable safety pipeline: a default-deny allowlist, enforced rate limits (2/min, 30/hour, 1000/day with warmup ramp), and an append-only audit log. Sends default to **draft mode** — the model proposes, a human approves with `wa draft approve`.

Requires the `wad` daemon running and paired (`wad` + `wa pair`). Install both from https://github.com/yolo-labz/wa/releases.

Advanced flags (`--toolsets`, `--profile`) can be added by editing this extension's generated server config.

send_mode.title: Send Mode
send_mode.description: draft = sends become human-review drafts (recommended); direct = sends go out immediately (allowlist + rate limits still apply); deny = send tools are not registered

read_only.title: Read-Only Mode
read_only.description: Expose only read tools (search, thread, contacts, status); all mutating tools are hidden

tools.name: wa_send_message
tools.description: Send (or draft) a WhatsApp message through the safety pipeline

tools.name: wa_get_thread
tools.description: Fetch recent messages of one chat

tools.name: wa_resolve_contact
tools.description: Resolve a name/phone to a JID

tools.name: wa_schedule_message
tools.description: Schedule a send for later (drafts respected)

tools.name: wa_draft_review
tools.description: List pending drafts awaiting human approval

tools.name: wa_wait_for_reply
tools.description: Block until a matching inbound event arrives
